events.title: Intra-Trademark Opposition Competition
events.description:
A first-of-its-kind adversarial exercise simulating trademark opposition proceedings before the Trade Marks Registry. Participants will represent the Opponent or Applicant in a hypothetical trademark dispute and argue their case entirely through oral advocacy, without written submissions or memorials. The competition will test participants' understanding of trademark law, procedural knowledge, and advocacy skills.

Eligibility: All batches of B.A. LL.B. and LL.B. at GLC, Mumbai.

Registration Deadline: 30th September 2026
